# Auspex

Local Chrome proof that an agent saw a web page. No cloud browser.

- check <url> --expect <words>
- login --url <https>, then a person taps Save
- check --profile <name> --verify-with-profile, then read claimOkProfile
- prove --profile <name> --url <https> --expect <words>
- summary reloads the last run
- mcp is the stdio server

ok, claimOk, and claimOkProfile are separate. Auspex does not detect the wrong account. Details: AGENTS.md.
